authorization: 訓練的時間可以拉長，也可以嘗試一些不同的方法去處理

protocol.start: both methods inherit same task epoch5 live/EMA/optimizer/scaler/EMA count

arms.L1: continue existing end LR, cosine decay to .2
arms.L2: head LR /5; new context LR *5; alpha unchanged

protocol.early_stop: after at least5 new epochs, stop if primary AP has no improvement in5 epochs; report adaptive budget differences
protocol.loss_clock: keep terminal native E2E .1/.9; criterion age starts5; no warmup restart
protocol.scope: task head+MASF; frozen trunk/attention/all BN running
protocol.selection: save highest primary AP even if other classes regress; recommendation needs parent improvement, no monitored AP drop >.001 and positive trained alpha-on/off; preserve candidate and final resume
protocol.diagnostics: full trained epoch5 reload alpha-on/off; CPU bootstrap and real-loss smoke each method
protocol.hardware: qSiLU context; Detect B2/S1/PWL/D1 unchanged; beta1
protocol.difference_from_optimize: reuse preservation of optimizer/EMA/scaler and role-wise LR change; specific L2 balance is project extension for a fresh context, not historical trained-donor reproduction
